_about.role: Single Source of Truth for decomposed wardrobe layers, garment drape, and prop orientation.
_about.rule: Decomposing outer layers from inner garments prevents AI diffusion models from generating bare legs or omitting connected hoods.

turnaround.notes: The face, the pinned curls, and the scar through the character's own left eyebrow hold on every view. Outfits change by story day; this sheet is the body, not one costume.

front.description: Facing the camera. Warm brown skin, dark curls pinned up with loose strands at the temples, scar through the character's own left eyebrow. Both arms down so the left wrist is free for the watch.

back.description: Back to the camera. The pinned curls and the nape show. No hood unless the outfit's hood_or_cowl says there is one. The coat hem and the trouser hem are both visible.

profile_left.description: The character's own left side toward the camera. The scar through the left eyebrow is visible. The left wrist is the near wrist.

profile_right.description: The character's own right side toward the camera. The left-eyebrow scar is on the far side. The left wrist is the far wrist and may be partly hidden.

props._comment: CONTINUITY STRUCTURE: Intrinsic Anatomical Laterality & Chirality Invariant (Andrej Karpathy Self-Announcing Standard)
props._engineering_purpose: Prevents Diffusion Laterality Inversion by enforcing Intrinsic Coordinates over Deictic Screen Coordinates
props._projection_rule: When the character faces the camera, their Intrinsic Left hand projects to Screen Right. When their back is to the camera, their Intrinsic Left hand projects to Screen Left. All prompts compile through this projection matrix.
